name: app-crowdfunding-app-on-lilac-terrazzo-pedestals
title: Dark crowdfunding app on lilac terrazzo pedestals
whatItIs: A glassy phone stands among lilac terrazzo cylinders. The dark screen shows 'Explore' with tab pills, a large product card with a yellow-dial watch, a purple progress bar, funding stats and a lime plus button in the nav.
whatItMeans: Premium and playful; a dark UI with neon accents pops against soft pastel props.
techniques: Set a dark UI in a pastel 3D set for high contrast.
Use terrazzo pedestals as a stage that suggests a showroom.
Let one product image with a matching accent (yellow watch and lime) carry the screen.
Use a lime FAB in the centre of the tab bar.

vocabulary.definition: A speckled surface texture used in props and backgrounds.
Cylindrical platforms used to display a product.
